title: Duke Farms
specs: Located on 2,700 acres in Hillsborough, New Jersey.
Restoring ecosystems, generating clean energy, and sharing knowledge.
Features reforested floodplains, pollinator meadows, solar power, and battery storage.
Eagle Cam with local eagles and their eaglets.

services.name: Bike Rentals
services.desc: Visitors are welcome to bring their own bicycles or rent one through Duke Farms’ self-service bike rental program. Bike rentals are available Tuesday through Saturday beginning at 8:30am. Bikes can be rented directly through the Movatic app from several rental locations throughout Duke Farms, providing a flexible and convenient way to explore at your own pace. Real-time bike availability is displayed in the app, making it easy to see where bikes are available before you begin your ride. blurb: Duke Farms is a living lab focused on ecosystem restoration, wildlife conservation, and clean energy transition. Visitors can explore trails, learn about conservation science and sustainability, and participate in nature experiences and programs. The site includes features like an Eagle Cam and reforested floodplains.
extraNote: Parking passes are required for Saturday visits (April–October). Reserve your free pass in advance.
